verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a self-serve sandbox, fully separate from production, that covers all products in the web app and API except Connected Account APIs. It comes with per-product simulation docs (payments, risk and others), an end-to-end sandbox payment quickstart, and a sandbox-default CLI and Developer MCP that can 'simulate events'. However, the evidence never mentions test card numbers or how to simulate declines or disputes, and the Connected Account exclusion means the sandbox does not fully mirror production. Missing for 10: documented test cards per scenario (declines, 3DS, etc.), explicit dispute/chargeback simulation in sandbox, Connected Account API sandbox parity, independent hands-on corroboration.
